headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.balancedExitWidth_le_common
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (b : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.BalancedVertices r c U L) (J hExit : ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.balancedExitWidth r c U L hr hc b J hExit ≤
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.commonExitWidth r c U L J hExit

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.joinedWidth_le_uniform
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (d : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (N hIn J hExit : ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.incomingWidth r c U L hr hc d N hIn +
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.commonExitWidth r c U L J hExit ≤
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.uniformStepWidth r c U L N hIn J hExit

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.uniformJoinedWord_law
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (d : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (N hIn J hExit : ℕ),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.uniformJoinedWord r c U L hr hc d N hIn J hExit) =
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.actualJoinedLaw r c U L hr hc d N hIn J hExit

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.scheduledUniformJoinedWord_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    7 ≤ L →
      ∀
        (hp :
          2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)))
        (d : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (t : ℕ),
        OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
              (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.uniformJoinedWord r c U L hr hc d (t + 2) (t + 2)
                (Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.attempts OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance t)
                (Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.precision OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance t)))
            (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.idealJoinedLaw r c U L hr hc hp d) ≤
          Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic t
